## [4.0.0](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/compare/v3.12.0...v4.0.0) (2026-11-21)

### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES

* **LINE:** The patches no longer support LINE 26.14.0 and 26.15.1.
Patch LINE 26.16.0 on Android 11 or 12, and LINE 26.17.1 on Android 12L
or later.

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **LINE - Hide new item badges:** hide the "N" on the LINE Labs row ([5a4fef3](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/5a4fef3abe0a3f3c4c78f6e25ec28c6ee04a59d8))

### ✨ New Features

* **LINE - Andrew's Patch Setting:** show the screen in Japanese and Traditional Chinese ([0b28731](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/0b2873192bd56ce79c69c348a0aeeca1f757b7d3))
* **LINE - Block analytics:** stop LINE's usage events ([4c231ea](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/4c231ea22159b952e8fab9f862f5e566ca1d0dc2))
* **LINE - Disable LINE Premium:** add a switch in Andrew's Patch Setting ([52948c6](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/52948c6570100020e00b96564fddde72f687f591)), closes [#234](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/issues/234)
* **LINE - Unlock app icons:** show and unlock every app icon ([91ed919](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/91ed919f6c130b77b27529cba69b11f19a546f05)), closes [#234](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/issues/234)

### 🚀 Updated App Support

* **LINE:** add support for LINE 26.17.1 ([dc57eca](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/dc57eca7e9baa189ee40c96da76c6dbaf7e810fb))
* **LINE:** add support for LINE 26.18.2 ([39d9e65](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/39d9e6580e8187863fbdccda4a97ec303b75ae33))
* **LINE:** drop LINE 26.14.0 and 26.15.1 ([66f4655](https://github.com/andrewliang25/morphe-patches/commit/66f4655bc72c9a5a41a87a50a896e3637d84f097))

patches.name: [Ad] Block ad telemetry
patches.description: Stops Facebook watching for screenshots of ads and reporting which apps you install for ad attribution.

patches.name: [Ad] Block background ad prefetch
patches.description: Stops Facebook downloading ads and its ad model in the background, which saves data, battery and storage.

patches.name: [Ad] Disable Audience Network
patches.description: Stops Facebook serving ads to other apps. Those apps then show their own ads or none, and rewarded ads can fail.

patches.name: [Feed] Block feed auto refresh
patches.description: Keeps your place in the news feed when you come back to Facebook. Pull down to refresh the feed.

patches.name: [Feed] Hide page suggestions and promo cards
patches.description: Removes the items that Facebook adds to the feed, such as "Pages you may like", promo cards and surveys. "Suggested for you" posts stay.

patches.name: [Feed] Hide post prompts
patches.description: Removes the prompts Facebook adds inside a post, such as "Are you interested in this post?".

patches.name: [Feed] Hide sponsored posts
patches.description: Removes sponsored posts from the news feed, with no gap left behind.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore screens on re-signed builds
patches.description: Makes profiles and some Settings pages open again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches.name: [General] AMOLED black theme
patches.description: Makes Facebook's dark mode black instead of dark grey. Turn on dark mode in Facebook first. You can turn it off in Andrew's Patch Setting.

patches.name: [General] Andrew's Patch Setting
patches.description: Adds "Andrew's Patch Setting" to the top of the Facebook menu. There you can turn some patches on or off without patching again, and see the credits and licenses.

patches.name: [General] Hide affiliate product links
patches.description: Removes the product cards of affiliate shop links from Reels, feed posts and comments. The "Commission eligible" label stays.

patches.name: [General] Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of Facebook's in-app browser. Facebook pages still open in the app.

patches.name: [Reels] Download any reel
patches.description: Adds a Download button beside every reel. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.

options.description: Saves videos as H.264 with AAC sound, so that apps such as WhatsApp can send them. The device converts a video in another format. This makes the save slower and the file larger.

patches.name: [Reels] Hide interest prompts
patches.description: Removes the "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt from Reels.

patches.name: [Reels] Hide sponsored reels
patches.description: Removes ads from Reels and Watch, including product banners over a reel and ads inside a video.

patches.name: [Reels] Picture-in-picture
patches.description: Keeps a reel playing in a small window when you leave Facebook from the Reels tab. Only vertical reels get a window. Needs Android 12 or later.

patches.name: [Stories] Disable auto advance
patches.description: Keeps each story on the screen until you tap or swipe to the next one.

patches.name: [Stories] Download any story
patches.description: Adds Save to the menu of any story, including stories with music. Videos save at the best quality the player streams.

options.description: Saves videos as H.264 with AAC sound, so that apps such as WhatsApp can send them. The device converts a video in another format. This makes the save slower and the file larger.

patches.name: [Stories] Hide sponsored stories
patches.description: Removes ad cards from the story viewer, so swiping through stories only shows stories people posted.

patches.name: [Stories] View stories anonymously
patches.description: Stops Facebook telling the server which stories you saw, so you are not in the viewer list. Stories that you saw still show as seen on this device.

patches.name: [Ad] Hide ad views
patches.description: Hides LINE display ads: the LINE Ads banners, the Smart Channel banner in the chat list and Google AdManager ads.

patches.name: [Ad] Remove banner ads
patches.description: LINE no longer loads the Smart Channel banner ads. This patch makes the getBanners and getPrefetchableBanners responses null.

patches.name: [Call] Auto-record calls
patches.description: Starts recording a 1-to-1 LINE call as soon as it connects. LINE saves the recording. Turn on call recording in Settings > LINE Labs first, because LINE does not record while that switch is off. Recording a call without the other person's consent is illegal in some places. You are responsible for following the law where you are.

patches.name: [Call] Record calls without notifying
patches.description: Records a 1-to-1 LINE call without telling the other party: no on-screen banner and no spoken recording announcement. Recording a call without the other person's consent is illegal in some places. You are responsible for following the law where you are.

patches.name: [Call] Remove recording time limit
patches.description: Records a call until it ends. LINE stops voice recordings after 60 minutes and video recordings after 20 or 50 minutes.

patches.name: [Call] Save recordings to device
patches.description: Saves each call recording to the Movies/LINE folder on your phone instead of sharing it to Keep Memo, which refuses files over 1 GB.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide AI Friends button
patches.description: Removes the AI Friends button from the Chats tab header. The Album button shows in its place.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide Events button
patches.description: Removes the "Events" row from the slide-out menu in a chat room. Events is a different feature from LINE Calendar, and it opens a server-hosted page.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide LINE GIFT button
patches.description: Removes the LINE GIFT tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide Transfer button
patches.description: Removes the Transfer (LINE Pay) tile from the + attach menu in a chat room.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide attach menu extra tools
patches.description: Removes the server-provided tools (Poll, Schedule and more) from the + menu in a chat. Built-in tiles stay.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide calendar buttons
patches.description: Removes every LINE Calendar button: in the Chats tab, the chat toolbar and menus, and the Home tab.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide community button
patches.description: Removes the community (OpenChat) button from the top of the Chats tab header.

patches.name: [Chat] Hide tips under messages
patches.description: Hides the "CHECK" tips under some messages, such as a received video.

patches.name: [Chat] Keep chats unread
patches.description: When you open a chat, LINE does not mark it read or send a read receipt. "Mark as read" still works.

patches.name: [Chat] Keep unsent messages
patches.description: Keeps messages that others unsend in 1:1 and group chats, with a red "Unsent" label next to the time. OpenChat is not covered.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore Google login via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Makes "Continue with Google" work on a re-signed build, through MicroG-RE. Root Mount does not need it.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore biometric login
patches.description: Biometric login can be linked again on a re-signed build. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore chat backup sign-in via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Makes Google Drive chat backup and restore work on a re-signed build, through MicroG-RE. Root Mount does not need it.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore location maps via MicroG-RE
patches.description: Shows maps again on a re-signed build, with OpenFreeMap tiles. It needs MicroG-RE 7.0.0 or later. Root Mount does not need it.

patches.name: [Fix] Restore push notifications
patches.description: When LINE is fully closed, push notifications work again on a re-signed build. LINE also gets its Firebase Remote Config again. A Root Mount install does not need this patch.

patches.name: [General] Andrew's Patch Setting
patches.description: Adds "Andrew's Patch Setting" to LINE Settings, below "Profile". There you can turn some patches on or off without patching again, and see the credits and licenses.

patches.name: [General] Block analytics
patches.description: Stops LINE from sending usage events to its analytics service, such as the screens you open and the buttons you tap. Crash reports are not changed.

patches.name: [General] Custom font
patches.description: Adds a button to LINE's Font page to use a font file from your device. The page then no longer loads LINE's font list from the server.

patches.name: [General] Disable VOOM
patches.description: VOOM deep links, shares, and notifications do nothing. If you open the standalone VOOM feed, it closes. Messaging and the other tabs do not change.

patches.name: [General] Enable themes on sub devices
patches.description: Lets a sub device (a tablet or second phone logged in to the same account) use themes and the Black theme in dark mode. Hides the Theme Shop button there, because LINE does not open the shop on a sub device.

patches.name: [General] Hide Agent i buttons
patches.description: Removes Agent i from the Home header, the search bar, the Wallet tab header and Settings, and hides Agent i in chats permanently, with its "Show Agent i in chat" switch in the + menu.

patches.name: [General] Hide LINE AI image editing
patches.description: Removes the LINE AI image editing buttons: "AI Edit" in the message long-press menu, the button next to an image message, and the button in the chat, album, Note and profile photo viewers. The normal photo editor stays.

patches.name: [General] Hide new item badges
patches.description: Hides the green dots and N badges that mark new items, on header buttons, tabs, menus, lists and settings rows. Unread message counts do not change.

patches.name: [General] Open links in external browser
patches.description: Opens web links in your default browser instead of LINE's in-app browser. LIFF mini-apps and LINE links stay in LINE.

patches.name: [General] Redirect LINE Pay
patches.description: Opens LINE Pay in the standalone LINE Pay app, so the integrity check that fails on a re-signed build never runs.

patches.name: [General] Trust user-installed CAs
patches.description: Makes LINE trust certificate authorities you install, so your own HTTPS proxy can read LIFF and mini-app web traffic. Bank and LINE Pay stay pinned. For debugging. Off by default.

patches.name: [Home] Hide Home content feed
patches.description: Removes the content feed below the friends list on the Home tab: LINE NEWS, official account posts and rankings.

patches.name: [Home] Hide Home modules
patches.description: Hides the recommended content, hot-topics and ad modules on the Home tab.

patches.name: [Premium] Disable LINE Premium
patches.description: Hides all LINE Premium upsells, badges and pages. It unlocks nothing, because the server enforces Premium.

patches.name: [Premium] Hide premium unsend upsells
patches.description: Removes the Premium unsend upsells that "Disable LINE Premium" leaves. Ordinary unsend still works.

patches.name: [Premium] Unlock app icons
patches.description: Shows the App icon page in Settings, also with "Disable LINE Premium" on. It also lists the collaboration icons that are in the app but not offered now. You can apply every icon on the page, also the Premium ones.

patches.name: [Tab] Hide LINE TODAY tab
patches.description: Removes the LINE TODAY (News) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the news-tab and news-row layouts.

patches.name: [Tab] Hide Shopping tab
patches.description: Removes the Shopping tab from the main bottom navigation. This includes the Japan variant (Shopping, ショッピング) and the Taiwan variant (Discover, 逛逛).

patches.name: [Tab] Hide VOOM tab
patches.description: Removes the VOOM (formerly Timeline) tab from the main bottom navigation.

patches.name: [Tab] Hide Wallet tab
patches.description: Removes the Wallet (LINE Pay) tab from the main bottom navigation, in both the normal and mini-tab layouts.
